items.title: Bill Easley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 1, 2021
items.q: And some of them, Cannonball made a statement one time on “Live to New York” and he talked about people who act like they’re supposed to be hip or something.

ctx.x: Being a musician and being in all these different situations, did your intense behavior at looking at other people’s behavior, did music give you a chance to observe a lot of different kinds of personalities?

Sure. And some people, you know they have certain things that they think are unique to musicians. By my study musicians are just people just like everybody else. And some of them, Cannonball made a statement one time on “Live to New York” and he talked about people who act like they’re supposed to be hip or something. Do you remember that statement?
